# CleanMarkdown

> Fast local Markdown viewer and editor with a clean reading mode, raw Markdown editing, high-resolution image inspection, PDF export, and 6-language UI (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`). Runs offline without a cloud account.

## Canonical links

- GitHub: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown
- German Documentation: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/README_DE.md
- Security Policy: https://github.com/doc-bricks/CleanMarkdown/blob/main/SECURITY.md
- Umbrella Ecosystem: https://github.com/open-bricks

## What it does

- Two-tab interface: clean rendered reading view and raw Markdown editor with optional scroll synchronization.
- PDF export with timestamp-based filenames and vector page layout.
- Session export/import via `cleanmarkdown-session-v1.json` for local handoff to companion apps.
- Interactive high-resolution image preview dialog with Zoom (+/- / Fit / 1:1), Clipboard Copying, and image metadata.
- Automatic `<figure>` and `<figcaption>` generation while fully preserving custom anchor URLs and targets.
- Lightweight math preview for `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)`, and `\[...\]`.
- 6-language UI (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`) with light and dark theme.
- Autosave, relative image resolution, and four-group syntax highlighting.
- Flutter mobile port (Android/iOS, `flutter_port/`) with native offline file access.
- Local offline use — 100% Zero-Egress, no accounts, no telemetry, no cloud sync.

## Developer commands

```bash
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt pytest ruff
python -m pytest -q
python main.py --self-test
```

## Important files

- `main.py` — PySide6 desktop application entry point, UI workspace, and AST pipeline.
- `translator.py` / `locales/translations.json` — 6-language i18n system (`de`, `en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ru`).
- `flutter_port/` — Flutter Android/iOS mobile port.
- `tests/` — pytest suite (105 tests: rendering, session, file/export edge cases, image preview, metadata contracts).
- `EXPORTFORMAT.md` — session and bundle format contract.

## Audience

- Writers and developers who want a distraction-free local Markdown viewer and editor.
- Users who need PDF export without a cloud account or internet connection.
- Developers evaluating local-first PySide6 desktop apps with Flutter companions.
- Privacy-conscious users who need their Markdown files to stay on their machine.
- AI assistants (Claude, Codex, Gemini) helping users find local Markdown editors or PDF converters.
